ingress.description: IPv4 and IPv6 addresses that clients write to their A and AAAA records.

version.description: The Jetbridge release this Provider runs.

operator.description: The atproto account of whoever runs this Provider.

protocol.description: The protocol version this Provider accepts.

admission.description: Who may open a tunnel: open (anyone), approval (Clients with an unexpired link.jetbridge.approval record) or closed (by out-of-band invitation only).

activePolicies.description: The link.jetbridge.policy records a Client may accept, in the Provider's order of preference. A Client must accept one of them.

main.description: A provider's offer of ingress to other people's HTTPS services. Lives in the provider's repo. The repo's DID identifies the provider.

trafficCap.description: Caps on one Client's traffic, each over a rolling period. Left out when there is no cap. If a Client's traffic goes over any cap during its period, the Client must expect the Provider to throttle or cut its connections.

maxHostnames.description: Most hostnames one client may serve at once.

bytes.description: The most bytes the Client may send in this direction during the period.

timespan.description: The length of the rolling period the Provider will limit over.

direction.description: ingress: bytes from visitors to the Client via the Provider. egress: bytes from the Client to visitors via the Provider.

trafficCap.description: A cap on the traffic of all of one Client's hostnames together, in one direction, over a rolling period.
